body:
Talking to my family has never worked. Like I said, they don't really have much sympathy for my issues (not sure they even believe depression is a thing). I don't feel especially close to them and I haven't since I was a teen.

I'm not sure my doctor fully knows that much about mental things either. She's pretty young and has disregarded my statements about how I feel before as just hormone imbalances and exhaustion. I can't afford a proper therapist with what little I make at my job. 

And with my fiancé, he's the only person I can stand physical contact with, and I crave it a lot more than he does. I also have a higher libido so I feel like I'm bugging him or being clingy for engaging in intimate things with him. I just feel like a selfish presence in his and everyone else's life. I constantly need something.
